newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco to issue treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Morocco to issue treasury bills.

text.p: Morocco's central bank said on Monday it would issue treasury bills this month each valued at 5,000 and 50,000 dirhams ($533 and $5,330).
A spokeswoman for Bank Al-Maghrib (central bank) said subscriptions would be open from March 24 to 28.
Interest rates would be 8.5 percent for one year, 9 percent for three years and 9.5 percent for five years.
The central bank issues treasury bills four times a year, she said. The last issue dates back to December 1996.
